notes: The exact mapping below follows the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador API header. Two foreign object handles are registered so the test can choose one that is unequal to the sole local object handle; this avoids treating an equal opaque handle value from another execution as evidence of foreign identity.

requirements.statement: Section 10.8 declares getObjectInstanceName(ObjectInstanceHandle const&) and ObjectInstanceNotKnown. The scenario verifies a selected foreign execution handle resolves in that execution but is not known to the local execution.
